# Bankruptcy for Credit Cards [2026]
> Last updated: 2026-09-25

> Bankruptcy for credit cards: complete 2026 filing guide comparing Chapter 7 vs Chapter 13, local exemptions, filing costs, means test

## About
creditcarddebtbankruptcy.org is part of the Open Bankruptcy Project (openbankruptcyproject.org), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit building free, open-source tools for bankruptcy court transparency.
